name: smartBOX Furniture Manufacturing, LLC
old_description: A smart, spacious, one-person office pod optimized for video calls and designed for focus work. Built smart. Made to last.
about:
SmartBox Furniture Manufacturing, LLC is headquartered in Scottsdale, Arizona, with its central manufacturing facility located in nearby Tempe. The company was founded with a vision to improve workplace well-being and productivity by creating thoughtfully engineered phone booths and work pods. Ownership details and founder names have not been publicly disclosed.

The company produces a line of modular privacy solutions including office phone booths, work pods, solo booths, triple booths, and health pods. Each unit integrates square tempered sliding glass doors with sidelights, adjustable LED lighting, occupancy sensors, and an active air-circulation system with intake and exhaust fans. Acoustic PET panels are designed to reduce sound transmission by up to 35 dB. Units ship with dual power outlets, USB-C ports, and locking casters for mobility, and are designed for assembly in under one hour by two people.

SmartBox serves modern office environments, coworking operators, and commercial interiors, collaborating with architects, designers, and office furniture dealers. Notable installations include the coworking provider Kiln and the public-safety technology firm Axon, both based in the Phoenix metro area. End-users cited in testimonials include design professionals, facility managers, and operations managers who value acoustic privacy, predictable lead times, and ease of installation.

The company emphasizes its U.S.-based manufacturing as a differentiator, citing reliable lead times and consistent craftsmanship. It markets the only fully ADA-compliant work booth solution in its category, combining sustainable materials, accessibility, and a mobile design that avoids costly teardown and reassembly.

name: 35th Avenue Sew & Vac
old_description: We pride ourselves on providing the highest quality of customer service.
about:
35th Avenue Sew & Vac is a family-owned retailer of sewing machines, vacuums, and fabrics based in Chandler, Arizona, with additional locations in Phoenix and El Mirage. The company has served the Phoenix metropolitan area for approximately 40 years and is now operated by the second generation of the founding family.

The company operates three retail stores and an event center, with its flagship Phoenix location spanning 24,000 square feet and stocking roughly 20,000 bolts of fabric alongside dozens of sewing machine models. As an authorized dealer, it carries machines and accessories from brands such as Baby Lock, Bernina, Elna, Handi Quilter, Husqvarna Viking, Juki, and Pfaff, as well as vacuums from Beam, Bissell, Miele, Riccar, and others. In addition to sales, 35th Avenue provides longarm quilting services for customer quilts and runs a full-service repair shop capable of servicing nearly any brand of sewing machine or vacuum.

Its customer base includes quilting and sewing hobbyists, embroidery enthusiasts, and homeowners seeking vacuum solutions, with the company shipping orders nationwide through its e-commerce site.

The business emphasizes high-quality customer service and positions itself as a one-stop shop for quilting, sewing, and embroidery needs.

name: 4M Metals - by Sentrigard
old_description: fabrication experts in the Low Country and surrounding areas.
about:
4M Metals, based in Ridgeland, South Carolina, was established in September 2006. The company operates as a supplier and fabricator of metal roofing components for the Low Country region, including Beaufort and Savannah.

The shop runs modern computerized folding and shearing machines alongside panel roll formers, enabling in-house production of custom trim flashing packages and on-site panel fabrication. The facility stocks over 35 colors in materials such as painted galvalume, aluminum, stainless steel, and copper, and serves both commercial and residential roofing projects as well as flat-roof applications. Staff experience totals more than 50 years in metal roofing and sheet metal fabrication.

Customers range from roofing contractors and construction firms to homeowners across the Low Country and coastal areas. The company also fabricates related items such as chimney caps, windscreens, HVAC ductwork, countertop wraps, backsplashes, cupolas, louvers, and full building-envelope flashing. It holds manufacturer certifications for coastal-climate metal performance and assists clients in locating qualified installers.

4M Metals emphasizes its investment in up-to-date forming technology, quick turnaround on custom flashing, and a combined 75-plus years of hands-on fabrication knowledge among its team as factors that distinguish its service in the region.

name: 515 Customized Woodworks LLC
old_description: See us 2026 DSM Fairgrounds Arts- Crafts Shows, March 13-15, Sept 25-27 & Nov13-15
about:
515 Customized Woodworks LLC operates from Pleasant Hill, Iowa, serving the Greater Des Moines metro area. The company is organized as a small business LLC and has exhibited at the Des Moines fairgrounds arts and crafts shows for the past six years. No founding year or founder names are disclosed.

The shop builds custom, stand-alone furniture pieces including live-edge tables (coffee, dining, entry), drop-zone tables, and its signature Dog Den pet enclosures. Work is performed in a climate-controlled storage facility using locally harvested, kiln-dried hardwoods such as walnut, locust, elm, ash, and white oak up to 2.5 inches thick. Processes include epoxy repair and decorative inlay, spray-applied protective topcoats, and fabrication of both metal and hand-made wood leg systems. The company does not build chairs or handle built-in installations.

Customers are primarily residential buyers in the Des Moines region who commission one-off pieces or purchase from inventory shown at the Callahan Productions arts and crafts shows. The Dog Den line targets pet owners seeking a furniture-grade alternative to wire kennels, with sizes scaled to traditional kennel dimensions. The business does not ship outside Iowa; delivery is offered within the metro area for a fee, and customers may also pick up at the storage facility by appointment.

The company emphasizes a “hand-crafted with pride, not manufactured” philosophy, highlighting the uniqueness of each live-edge slab and the use of local materials. A 50% deposit is required to begin a custom project, with the balance due on completion.

name: 5N Plus Semiconductors
old_description: Moteur de performance essentiel aux technologies et produits de tous les jours
about:
5N Plus is headquartered in Montréal, Québec, and was founded in 2000. The company is publicly traded on the Toronto Stock Exchange (TSX:VNP) and operates production and R&D centers across North America, Europe, and Asia, including a major manufacturing facility in St. George, Utah.

The company produces specialized semiconductors and high-performance materials using proprietary technologies. Its product portfolio includes germanium wafers, cadmium telluride (CdTe) for terrestrial solar cells, gallium arsenide components for defense applications, cadmium zinc telluride (CZT) for medical imaging and industrial detection, bismuth-based alloys, and active pharmaceutical ingredients. A 50% expansion of the St. George facility is underway to increase capacity for defense, space solar, and medical markets.

5N Plus serves critical industries such as space solar power, terrestrial renewable energy, medical imaging and detection, pharmaceuticals, technical materials, and defense. Its materials are often the critical component in customers' end products, including satellites, solar panels, medical detectors, and defense systems.

Since its inception, 5N Plus has emphasized sustainable growth and circular economy principles, leveraging R&D and exclusive processes to transform metals into value-added specialized materials. The company states that its proprietary technologies and advanced manufacturing capabilities enable it to deliver critical materials that are essential to its clients' technologies.

The business specializes in supplying OEM used auto parts to both retail customers and commercial repair shops. Its inventory is searchable via an online stock-check tool, and the company advertises next-day service for parts fulfillment.
